Usage: agent acp [options]

Start the Cursor Agent as an ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server

Options:
  -h, --help  Display help for command

Usage: agent install [options] <version> [urlPrefix]

Install Cursor Agent with specified version and URL prefix

Options:
  -h, --help  Display help for command

Usage: agent update [options]

Update Cursor Agent to the latest version

Options:
  -h, --help  Display help for command

Usage: agent status|whoami [options]

View authentication status

Options:
  --format <format>  Output format (choices: "text", "json", default: "text")
  -h, --help         Display help for command

Usage: agent about [options]

Display version, system, and account information

Options:
  --format <format>  Output format (choices: "text", "json", default: "text")
  -h, --help         Display help for command
